description: This file manages the creation and updating of an 'official channel' catalog for extensions within a repository. It scans a specific directory for extension packages, reads their package.json files, extracts relevant openclaw-related metadata, and generates a sorted catalog JSON file. It also includes functionality to write this catalog to disk when run directly.

methods.name: buildOfficialChannelCatalog
methods.description: Scans the 'extensions' directory for packages, reads their package.json, and builds a catalog of openclaw channels.

methods.name: writeOfficialChannelCatalog
methods.description: Generates the official channel catalog and writes it to a JSON file at a specified relative path.
